description: ✅ No API key needed. Fetch the public receipt of a finalized benchmark run. Use it to verify a score independently. Arg: run_id. Returns receipt_hash, the immutable payload (answer digests only), anchor evidence, basescan_tx_url, the bank commit_root and verify_hints; score_opening appears once the benchmark closes. Not found until the run is scored. Keyless and keyed calls get the same receipt. REST twin: GET /api/v1/benchmarks/runs/{run_id}/receipt. Next: benchmark_commitment.

run_id.description: UUID of a finalized run (benchmark_my_runs lists yours).
run_id.title: Run Id

name: benchmark_run_receipt
